prompts.prompt: Create one wide 16:9 hand-drawn educational illustration for a high-school AI study lesson, matching ink outlines and soft watercolor shading on cream dotted notebook paper, with restrained teal, purple and golden accents. The concept is getting a different explanation of the same idea. Show a tablet on the left with a simple clear picture of a circle divided into four equal parts, three filled purple; on the right a notebook with a bar divided into four equal parts, three filled purple. A gently curving hand-drawn two-way arrow links them. Both clearly represent the same fraction 3/4 in different visual forms. No equations or numerical labels needed. Large uncluttered readable objects, generous margins, pleasant sketchbook texture, subtle desk props only. No heading, no panels or course-style board, no people, no logos, no watermark. Make the correspondence exact: four equal parts and three filled in each representation. Output 16:9.
